_comment: Audit targets. 'full' targets run the complete consent + OAuth + AIS flow and active tests. 'passive' targets only get unauthenticated, read-only probes (discovery, TLS, mTLS enforcement, header validation). Keep public bank endpoints passive.

targets.name: TBC Bank (public test environment)
targets.note: Documented at developers.tbcbank.ge (no downloadable spec). XS2A host and token endpoint require a client certificate (tls_client_auth). Test certificates and a test user requested from TBC; the sandbox journey starts once they are in certs/tbc/.

targets.name: TBC Bank BIS - Accounts (test, proprietary)
targets.note: TBC's own business API (not NextGenPSD2): judged against TBC's documentation. Read-only: token, movements, statement, balance, documented errors. Transfers are never called.

targets.name: ProCredit Bank Georgia
targets.note: Spec: the bank's test API document (servers online-test.procreditbank.ge/0.8/v1, not reachable from outside); production endpoint probed.

targets.name: Paysera Bank Georgia (v0.8)
targets.note: No sandbox (confirmed by Paysera support, Oct 23): production only, access needs an NBG TPP licence and a QWAC from a CA recognised in Georgia, registered by Paysera; no test user. Documentation is web pages only (developers.paysera.com), no OpenAPI file, so only read-only front-door probes run.

targets.name: Bank of Georgia (sandbox)
targets.note: Sandbox access obtained by the team: Bank of Georgia issued test certificates (QWAC + QSealC) and a test user (BOG_OB_SBX, OTP 4444) on request. Full journey: mTLS, signed requests, OAuth, bank login, account reads.

targets.name: Liberty Bank (sandbox)
targets.note: Sandbox access obtained by the team: test certificate from Liberty's developer portal (certs/liberty/), demo user demo/demo, OTP 1234. Paths from the bank's published spec (/0.8/v1/...).

targets.name: Silk Bank (sandbox)
targets.note: Sandbox access obtained by the team: test certificate from Silk's developer portal (certs/silk/), demo user demo/demo, OTP 1234. Paths from the bank's published spec (v2.0, /v2/...).

targets.name: Cartu Bank (sandbox)
targets.note: Cartu's certificate download returned 404, so the journey uses the team's Silk test certificate (same Alta Software platform); a refusal is reported as not testable. Demo user demo/demo, OTP 1234. Spec v2.0 (/v2/...).

targets.name: Credo Bank (sandbox)
targets.note: Sandbox host and demo user (testclient / testclient, OTP 111111) published on Credo's portal. Sandbox certificate and client ID requested; the journey starts once they are in certs/credo/ and CREDO_CLIENT_ID / CREDO_CLIENT_SECRET are set.

targets.name: Terabank (published spec only)
targets.note: Only the OpenAPI document is checked: the developer portal shows an error and no sandbox host is published.

targets.name: PASHA Bank Georgia (published spec only)
targets.note: Only the OpenAPI document is checked: the developer portal shows an error and no sandbox host is published.

_sources: Banks and portals: NBG list of ASPSPs, https://nbg.gov.ge/en/page/open-banking-detailed-data-and-documentation. 'source' = page where the endpoint was found; 'note' = what is assumed.
